shortDescription.default: Internal marketplace for SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.

longDescription.default: Enterprise Classifieds 365 is a SharePoint Framework package for SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams. This package contains one client-side web part named Enterprise Classifieds 365. That web part is supported on modern SharePoint pages, as a SharePoint full-page app, and in Microsoft Teams as a channel tab and a personal app. This package does not include an application customizer, field customizer, form customizer, list view command set, or any other SharePoint Framework extension. Employees can post listings, search, message, and moderate items inside the customer Microsoft 365 tenant. A 14-day trial starts on first use of a SharePoint site. One yearly subscription covers everyone on that site.
